scope: APT Sessions and projections, Session-to-Dispatch links, research capture, Reference Scout and compatibility Probe records, reference delivery evidence, claims, checks, queries, and read-only persisted examples.
excluded_scope: Fresh host smoke, new subagent launches beyond the declared pair, network access, browser execution, mutation of the real runtime store, product-code changes, documentation repair, and attribution of the recorded source drift.
executive_answer: The implementation provides a declared, integrity-linked skeleton for reconstruction, not a complete record of reasoning or work. When records are admitted, it can pin a Session to an immutable Dispatch snapshot, retain actor and attempt identities, seal selected inputs and raw research output, preserve typed facts and Scout evidence, and rebuild projections after restart. It does not yet guarantee that every real host turn enters that graph, persist every turn's exact terminal output, require a disposition for every expected contribution, or connect references to claims through independent checks. The live store demonstrates 180 Dispatch links, 22 resolved bindings and 415 ingestions, but only one Scout and one APT capture with six facts; no agent Attempt or reference-delivery record exists. This AS-BUILT investigation itself has a registered Dispatch but zero runtime links, bindings, ingestions, Scouts or captures. A cold third party can recover pieces of declared intent and accepted evidence, but cannot yet reconstruct why all work was legitimately authorized, exactly what each agent received and produced, or why the result should be believed.
property_served: Honest reconstruction of work and reasoning: a third party can follow objective, declared authority, context, actor, action, result and evidence without inventing missing links or collapsing delivery, observation, use and support.

gaps.statement: Real host work can occur without a Session/Dispatch link and bound seat receipt; the current investigation is such an orphan.
gaps.property_lost: Coverage and attribution: the harness cannot know whether its durable memory contains all expected work.
gaps.smallest_next_action: Enforce host adoption and reconcile every expected seat, turn, follow-up and terminal transition from the pinned Dispatch against accepted runtime bindings. First missing link: this Dispatch's Session-to-Dispatch link, followed by per-turn bindings.
gaps.what_it_buys: Detects work outside memory and establishes the denominator for reconstructibility before richer semantics are added.
gaps.completion_evidence: A report for a real dispatch shows every expected turn mapped exactly once to accepted link/binding/terminal receipts, with explicit missing, orphaned and extra categories.

gaps.statement: Terminal bindings do not commit the exact output or effects produced by the bound turn.
gaps.property_lost: The system knows who terminated but not what they durably produced or changed.
gaps.smallest_next_action: Persist one content-addressed terminal output/effect artifact atomically with each binding's terminal transition. First missing link: binding/Attempt to exact durable output.
gaps.what_it_buys: Makes 'who did what' answerable and prevents later files from being falsely attributed to a terminal producer.
gaps.completion_evidence: A cold reader verifies the terminal artifact digest and effects for every bound turn, and rejects substituted or absent output.

gaps.statement: Expected contributions are not required to reach a captured, partial, missing or checked disposition.
gaps.property_lost: Silence is indistinguishable from omitted capture, failed work or an intentionally absent contribution.
gaps.smallest_next_action: Derive expected contributions from the pinned Dispatch and require an explicit capture/check disposition for each. First missing link: expected contribution to accepted outcome record.
gaps.what_it_buys: Turns sparse success examples into measurable completion and preserves failures and absences without guessing.
gaps.completion_evidence: Every expected contribution reconciles to exactly one current captured/partial/missing disposition after restart and replay.

gaps.statement: Declared rationale, authority evidence and epistemic support remain prose or unimplemented specification rather than independently checkable runtime relations.
gaps.property_lost: A reader cannot separate declared decision-maker from verified entitlement, or source delivery/use from support for a claim.
gaps.smallest_next_action: After coverage/output/disposition are closed, persist declared decider, authorization evidence and verification status separately, then implement typed reference/claim checks with checker, method/version, outcome and exact selector. First missing links: Dispatch to declared decision evidence, and claim to independently checked reference evidence.
gaps.what_it_buys: Explains why work was allowed and why a conclusion is supported without turning declarations or digests into authority or truth.
gaps.completion_evidence: Cold fixtures distinguish unverified decider evidence from externally verified status and distinguish delivered, observed, claimed_consulted, supports and contradicts across independent check chains.

gaps.statement: Reconstruction requires expert joins across the YAML ledger, runtime journal/database, protected artifacts and repository outputs.
gaps.property_lost: A third party cannot obtain one bounded, explicit account of work and its unknowns.
gaps.smallest_next_action: Only after G1-G4, add a non-authoritative joined reconstruction read model that traverses existing owners and labels every missing edge. First missing link: binding/output/contribution join in the read surface.
gaps.what_it_buys: Makes durable memory usable for review, recovery and continuation without inventing joins or copying write authority.
gaps.completion_evidence: One cold fixture produces the same graph and narrative after restart/rebuild, includes exact evidence selectors and explicitly reports unavailable edges as unknown.
